title: Deep-research workflow (multi-angle sweep)
description:
Second shipped Workflow script: a deep-research fan-out the orchestrator can OFFER before heavy/unfamiliar research, complementing (not replacing) the researcher subagent.

Rides entirely on TASK-037's infrastructure: the generic workflows/ materializer picks the new file up with ZERO code changes — this ticket adds one workflow source file, its dogfood parity copy, and skill prose.

DESIGN (locked by orchestrator):
(a) workflows/deep-research.js — args is the research question (string). Body: parallel multi-angle sweep with >=4 distinct lenses (official docs, real-world code examples, community issues/pitfalls, alternatives & comparisons), each agent returning schema-validated {claims, sources}; a synthesis stage merging into a structured result; a completeness-critic stage that names what is missing (unread sources, unverified claims, angles not covered). Returns {summary, key_facts: [{fact, source, confidence}], gaps, sources}. No model overrides; no Date.now()/Math.random() (harness restriction).
(b) Knowledge-flow rule (prose, orchestrator-routing skill): the KB-first contract is unchanged — knowledge/ graph + KB lookup BEFORE any web research (TASK-035 protocol); deep-research is offered only when the KB misses and the question is broad enough to need multiple angles; the workflow's result feeds the researcher's normal outputs (skill authoring / KB entry), it does not bypass them.
(c) Naming note: 'deep-research' may collide with a same-named user-level skill on some machines (it does on the dev machine); project-level .claude/workflows/ scoping makes this acceptable — do not rename.
(d) Like deep-review, the script cannot run under vitest; static-shape lock only, live run proven via UAT.
acceptance_criteria: Plugin-root workflows/deep-research.js exists and is a valid Workflow script: export const meta pure literal (name 'deep-research', description, phases), body runs >=4 distinct research lenses in parallel with schema-validated {claims, sources} outputs, a synthesis stage, and a completeness-critic stage; accepts the research question via args; returns {summary, key_facts, gaps, sources}.
.claude/workflows/deep-research.js is a byte-identical dogfood parity copy, covered by the TASK-037 parity spec (extend it if it enumerates files explicitly).
The existing materializer distributes the new file with zero materializer code changes (a spec proves deep-research.js lands in a fresh project's .claude/workflows/).

The orchestrator-routing skill (both parity copies) 'Deep workflows' section gains the deep-research offer rule: KB/graph lookup first (TASK-035 contract unchanged), offer only for broad unfamiliar-territory questions, human approves each run, results flow into the researcher's normal skill/KB outputs.
Static-shape regression lock for the new file (exists in both locations, meta parses with name 'deep-research'); no other new specs.
